# RAGbase Shield generic business words (French). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# Adjectives and nouns that start many company names ("Financière X", "Industrielle Y"). They are never
# the distinctive part of a company name on their own: no head-word variant, no label hit (R1, CL-18d).
